acceptance: A batch whose CI run registers 2 minutes after the push waits for the run and lands when the run is green.
A batch whose run never registers inside the bound stops with a clear message that names the bound.
A test drives both cases with an injected clock and a fake run lister.
fix: After the batch verb pushes a batch PR, wait for the required run of its tip to register, within a bounded time that policy owns, before it reports that no run exists. Report the wait in the batch output.
